heroHeadline: Diesel Tops ₱100/Liter as Third September Fuel Hike Lands; Visayas Grid Relapses to Yellow Alert
heroSubtitle: The M7.8 Mindanao earthquake and tsunami, Typhoon Bavi's landslides, and the Luis-Maymay-Neneng-Dolphin-Kujira-Obet-Pilandok storm sequence have killed 173+ across the cascade; NDRRMC's storm-sequence toll still holds at 44 dead, 18 injured and 5 missing (last updated Sept 10), with DSWD's most recent count showing 46,424 evacuees in 570 centers as of Sept 13. The Visayas grid, which briefly returned to normal operation on Sept 19 for the first time in nearly a month, slipped back to a yellow alert on Sept 21 after Therma Visayas Unit 1 and Panay Energy Development Corp's Unit 3 again went unavailable. Separately, a third major fuel-price hike effective Sept 22 — diesel +₱8.82/L, gasoline +₱4.88/L — pushed the national diesel average above ₱100/liter for the first time, driven by drone-attack damage to Saudi Arabia's East-West Pipeline and the wider Middle East conflict.
footerNote: Data sourced from official reports, major outlets, and institutional analyses.
